title: Inside the Hearts of Karate Girls

text_block_list.name: Narration
text_block_list.text: Kaya and Kaori have strengthened their bond. Their rapid advance continues.
text_block_list.orig_text: 絆を深めたカヤとカオリ。二人の快進撃が続く。

text_block_list.name: Kaori
text_block_list.text: This'll be the last~sa!
text_block_list.orig_text: これでラストさ～！

text_block_list.name: Monster
text_block_list.text: Gyaoooooo!
text_block_list.orig_text: ──ギャオオオオオッ！

text_block_list.name: Kaya
text_block_list.text: Aaah, no matter how many times I see it that technique of yours is simply amazing. If I could master it too, just how strong would I become, I wonder?
text_block_list.orig_text:
はぁー、
何度見てもすごい技だな。
こいつを習得すれば、
オレはもっと強くなれるんじゃないか？

text_block_list.name: Kaori
text_block_list.text: In that case... why don't you come and join us in Caon~sa? I'll teach you while we work together!
text_block_list.orig_text:
それなら
【自警団（カォン）】に出向すればいいさ～
一緒に仕事しながら教えてあげるよ～

text_block_list.name: カヤ
text_block_list.text:
おいおい、
ギャングが自警団に入れるかよ……
いや、
でも潜入という名目ならいけるのでは？
text_block_list.orig_text:
おいおい、
ギャングが自警団に入れるかよ……
いや、
でも潜入という名目ならいけるのでは？

text_block_list.name: Kaya
text_block_list.text: The other fighter, Makoto, also interests me... so maybe I should talk to the Boss about it.
text_block_list.orig_text:
もう一人の武闘派のマコトにも興味あるし、
ちょっとボスに相談してみてもいいかもな。

text_block_list.name: Kaori
text_block_list.text: Kaya you're a cute girl, so I'm sure Maho will be happy to accept~ She'll make you lots of cute frilly clothes~sa!
text_block_list.orig_text:
カヤはかわいいから、
マホもよろこぶよ～
いっぱいフリフリのかわいい服、
作ってくれるさ～

text_block_list.name: Kaya
text_block_list.text: Huh?! T-That's not really... uwah, frilly clothes... P-Pretend that I didn't say anything.
text_block_list.orig_text:
はぁ！？　
オ、
オレが、
フリフリの……
うわぁ、
想像したくねぇ……
い、
今の話はなかったことにしてくれ。

text_block_list.name: Kaori
text_block_list.text: Oh my, that's too bad... Hm? You two, look at this.
text_block_list.orig_text:
ありゃ～、
それは残念だよ～
……
ん？　
二人とも、
あれ見て。

text_block_list.name: Kaya
text_block_list.text: What's with this stone? Did the monster we just defeated drop it?
text_block_list.orig_text:
何だこの石？　
今倒した魔物から出てきたのか？

text_block_list.name: Kaori
text_block_list.text: It's so shiny and pretty!
text_block_list.orig_text:
ピカピカ光ってて
キレイだね～

text_block_list.name: Kaya
text_block_list.text: Hey, don't touch it so carelessly... Huh? Isn't the light getting stronger?
text_block_list.orig_text:
おい、
あんまうかつに触んなって……
あれ、
なんだか光が強くなってないか？

text_block_list.name: Kaori
text_block_list.text: Uwah! It's so bright~sa!
text_block_list.orig_text: とってもまぶしいさ～

text_block_list.name: Kaya
text_block_list.text: Hehe♪ Today's match is also a complete victory for me, Se-n-pa-i♪ Now then, what should I have you treat me to...?
text_block_list.orig_text:
ふふーん、
今日の勝負もアタシの完勝だね、
セ
・ン
・パ
・イ♪
さーて、
何おごってもらおうかなー？

text_block_list.name: Kaya
text_block_list.text: Ahaha, how many times have you said that by now? Starting with the punching machine... I've won in fighting games, rhythm games, and even puzzle games, you know?
text_block_list.orig_text:
あはは、
それ何度目の台詞？　
パンチングマシーンから始まって
格ゲーに音ゲー、
パズルゲーだってアタシの勝ちでしたよ？

text_block_list.name: Kaya
text_block_list.text: Well then, next time I'll challenge you to something you think you're good at. Well, even so, I don't feel like I'd ever lose♪
text_block_list.orig_text:
それじゃあ次は
先輩が得意なので勝負してあげるね。
まあ、
それでも全然負ける気しませんけど♪

text_block_list.name: Kaya
text_block_list.text: You're not good at giving up, are you? This happens because you get angry and challenge me again and again. You're technically my senpai, so you should conduct yourself better in front of your kouhai.
text_block_list.orig_text:
往生際が悪いなぁ？　
むきになって何度も挑んでくるからだよ。
一応先輩なんだから、
後輩の前では堂々としてくださいよ。

text_block_list.name: Kaya
text_block_list.text: Well, I'm not planning to act devilish, so I won't ask for anything extravagant. Look at me being a model kouhai for being able to take into consideration my senpai's financial situation♪
text_block_list.orig_text:
まあ、
アタシも鬼じゃないので
贅沢は言わないよ。
センパイの懐具合も考慮できるなんて、
後輩の鑑ですね♪

text_block_list.name: Kaya
text_block_list.text: Hey, Senpai, are you listening? Where are you looking?
text_block_list.orig_text:
って、
センパイ聞いてる？　
どこ見てんのさ？

text_block_list.name: Kaya
text_block_list.text: Hm. Senpai, it's not like I care about your love life or anything, but I do find it a little annoying when you bring up another girl's name while we're together.
text_block_list.orig_text:
む。
センパイの色恋とか別にどうでもいいけど、
二人でいる時によその女の名前出されるのはちょっとむかつくかも。

text_block_list.name: Kaya
text_block_list.text: So, this... Kaori-chan? What kind of girl is she... Wait, is that...?
text_block_list.orig_text:
で、
その香織ちゃん？　
ってのはどんな子……
ちょ、
あれって……

text_block_list.name: Kaori
text_block_list.text: I see~ So if I were to go there, I'd be able to eat all kinds of Okinawan sweets, huh?
text_block_list.orig_text:
なるほど～、
そこに行けば
沖縄のスイーツ食べ放題なんだね～？

text_block_list.name: Male
text_block_list.text: Yeah, they're all really delicious. I'm sure you'll enjoy them. It's just... the location is a little hard to find, so I'll show you around.
text_block_list.orig_text:
ああ、
どれもすごくおいしいんだ。
きっと君もよろこぶと思うな。
ただ、
場所がちょっと分かりにくいから
僕が案内してあげるよ。

text_block_list.name: Kaori
text_block_list.text: Aha~ Onii-san you're very kind~♪ It seems there are a lot of nice people in the city~sa!
text_block_list.orig_text:
あは～、
お兄さんとっても親切だね～♪
都会も優しい人がいっぱいさ～

text_block_list.name: Male
text_block_list.text: Haha, it's nothing really. Oh yeah, I'll introduce you to my friends later. Of course, they're also all kind and nice...
text_block_list.orig_text:
はは、
それほどでも。
そうだ、
後で僕の友達も紹介するよ。
もちろんみんな優しくて
気のいい奴らさ。

text_block_list.name: Kaya
text_block_list.text: Uwah... that sounds fishy. How would anyone fall for something like that? Senpai, what do you want to do?
text_block_list.orig_text:
うわぁ、
うさんくせぇ。
なんであんなのに引っかかっちゃうかな？
センパイ、
どうします？

text_block_list.name: Kaya
text_block_list.text: As expected. We can't just leave her alone like that. I'm off now, so wait here, senpai.
text_block_list.orig_text:
ですよね。
あれはさすがにほっとけないわ。
じゃあちょっと行ってくるんで
センパイはここで待ってて。

text_block_list.name: Kaya
text_block_list.text: Seriously, Kaori! You're so late! It's already way past our meeting time!
text_block_list.orig_text:
もー、
香織遅いじゃん！　
とっくに待ち合わせ時間過ぎてるって！

text_block_list.name: Male
text_block_list.text: Eh?
text_block_list.orig_text: え？

text_block_list.name: Kaori
text_block_list.text: Hmmmm~?
text_block_list.orig_text: んん～？

text_block_list.name: Kaya
text_block_list.text: Hey Kaori, who is this? You know him?
text_block_list.orig_text:
あれ香織、
この人誰？　
知り合い？

text_block_list.name: Kaori
text_block_list.text: Uh... No, I just met him a second ago~sa...
text_block_list.orig_text:
う、
ううん、
さっきはじめて会った人、
さ～

text_block_list.name: Kaya
text_block_list.text: I see. Onii-san, do you need something from my Kaori here?
text_block_list.orig_text:
そうなんだ。
お兄さん、
アタシの香織に何か用？

text_block_list.name: Male
text_block_list.text: U-Umm, I thought I'd show Kaori-chan to a certain store...
text_block_list.orig_text:
え、
ええと
香織ちゃんをお店まで案内しようかと……

text_block_list.name: Kaya
text_block_list.text: Ah, so that's what's going on. Then, can you tell me the name and location of the store? The two of us can go there together later.
text_block_list.orig_text:
あー、
そういうことねー。
じゃあお店の場所と名前教えて？
あとは二人で行けるんで。

text_block_list.name: Male
text_block_list.text: B-But just telling you the location would make it hard to find...
text_block_list.orig_text:
で、
でも
場所が分かりにくくて……

text_block_list.name: Kaya
text_block_list.text: Don't worry, I know my way around town. By the way, is there really a store like that around here?
text_block_list.orig_text:
大丈夫、
アタシこのへん詳しいんで。
ていうか
本当にそんなお店あるんですかぁ？

text_block_list.name: Male
text_block_list.text: O-Of course... if you'd like, you can come along too...
text_block_list.orig_text:
も、
もちろん……
よかったら君も一緒に──

text_block_list.name: Kaya
text_block_list.text: Ahaha, right on cue♪ Whatever, let's go, Kaori. I'll take you to a store that I personally recommend♪
text_block_list.orig_text:
あはは、
間に合ってまーす♪　
もういいや、
行こ？　
香織。
アタシのおススメのお店連れてったげる♪

text_block_list.name: Kaori
text_block_list.text: Ahaaa~ I wonder what's going on here~sa!
text_block_list.orig_text:
あは～
何が何やらさ～

text_block_list.name: Kaya
text_block_list.text: Oiii, Senpai. Rescue succesful.
text_block_list.orig_text:
おーいセンパイ、
無事救出してきたよ。

text_block_list.name: Kaori
text_block_list.text: Huh? {0}? Haitaiiii~♪ So you two know each other~sa? Ah, I see~ So that's why you knew my name~
text_block_list.orig_text:
あれ、
キミ？　
ハイタ～イ♪　
二人は知り合いだったさ～？
あ～そっか～、
だから私の名前知ってたんだね～

text_block_list.name: Kaya
text_block_list.text: Exactly so. You should be grateful to Senpai, you know. If I hadn't come to save you from that man trying to hit on you, who knew what would've happened.
text_block_list.orig_text:
そういうこと。
センパイに感謝しなよ？
あそこで助けに行かなかったら、
あのナンパ男に何されてたか。

text_block_list.name: Kaori
text_block_list.text: Huh? He was trying to hit on me?
text_block_list.orig_text:
え、
あれナンパだったの～？

text_block_list.name: Kaya
text_block_list.text: Uwah... so you actually didn't notice. What on earth did he say to you?
text_block_list.orig_text:
うわぁ、
やっぱり気付いてなかったよ。
いったいアイツに何言われたのさ？

text_block_list.name: Kaori
text_block_list.text: Hmm, I went to buy some snacks at an Okinawa antenna shop, but I found it closed. I was very disappointed, but then that man called out to me~sa.
text_block_list.orig_text:
ん～、
沖縄のアンテナショップにおやつ買いに行ったらお休みで、
ガッカリしてたところに
声をかけられたさ～

text_block_list.name: Kaori
text_block_list.text: He said he'd show me around a shop selling delicious Okinawan sweets.
text_block_list.orig_text:
おいしい沖縄スイーツのお店があるから
案内するって言ってたよ～

text_block_list.name: Kaya
text_block_list.text: ...Ahh. Senpai, will this girl be okay? Isn't she a little too naive?
text_block_list.orig_text:
……
センパイ、
この子大丈夫？　
ちょっと天然すぎじゃない？

text_block_list.name: Kaya
text_block_list.text: That's exactly the problem here! She's too nice for her own good, just like you! Geez, what the hell's wrong with you two?!
text_block_list.orig_text:
いい子過ぎるのが問題だっつってんの！
もう、
なんなんだよアンタら！

text_block_list.name: Kaori
text_block_list.text: Now, now... if you get that angry, your cute face will be ruined~sa!
text_block_list.orig_text:
まあまあ、
そんなに怒ったら
かわいい顔が台無しさ～

text_block_list.name: Kaya
text_block_list.text: Yeah, I wonder whose fault it is for that... Hah, forget it. Kaori, Senpai's treating us today, so let's go eat something sweet together.
text_block_list.orig_text:
いや、
誰のせいだと……
はあ、
もういいや。
香織、
センパイがおごってくれるから
一緒に甘いものでも食べに行こう。

text_block_list.name: Kaori
text_block_list.text: Really? But right now... I'm just craving Okinawan sweets~
text_block_list.orig_text:
本当に？　
でも、
今の私は
沖縄スイーツ腹なんだよね～

text_block_list.name: Kaya
text_block_list.text: I've got no problem with that. If you're not fed properly, you'll get caught up into something strange like earlier, so come with us.
text_block_list.orig_text:
それに関しては問題ないから。
ちゃんと食べさせておかないと
また変なのに引っかかりそうだから付いてきて。

text_block_list.name: Kaori
text_block_list.text: Ahaha, thank you very much! Umm...
text_block_list.orig_text:
あは～、
ありがとうね！　
ええと……

text_block_list.name: Kaya
text_block_list.text: Ah, come to think of it, I haven't introduced myself yet. I'm Kidou Kaya. You can just call me Kaya.
text_block_list.orig_text:
ああ、
そう言えば名乗ってなかったね。
アタシは鬼道嘉夜。
嘉夜でいいよ。

text_block_list.name: Kaori
text_block_list.text: I'm Kyan Kaori. Nice to meet you, Kaya♪
text_block_list.orig_text:
私は喜屋武香織だよ～。
よろしくね、
嘉夜♪

text_block_list.name: Kaori
text_block_list.text: Mmmmmmmm, this is very delicious! The taste's just as good as the one back home!
text_block_list.orig_text:
ん～
でーじおいしいね～！　
故郷の味に全然負けてないよ～

text_block_list.name: Kaya
text_block_list.text: Luckily, there was an Okinawan sweets fair going on at a nearby convenience store. Well then, I think I'll have some too♪
text_block_list.orig_text:
ちょうどコンビニで沖縄スイーツフェアやっててよかったよ。
それじゃあ
アタシもいただこうかな♪

text_block_list.name: Kaya
text_block_list.text: Ah! They really are delicious! The sweetness and aroma of the brown sugar is amazing. I'm not very familiar with Okinawan things unlike Kaori, but I think I might get addicted to those sweets.
text_block_list.orig_text:
わっ、
本当においしい！　
黒糖の甘味と香り、
すごくいいな。
沖縄のものってちょっとなじみが薄いけど、
結構ハマりそうかも。

text_block_list.name: Kaori
text_block_list.text: I'm sorry... I ended up getting treated to a delicious meal...
text_block_list.orig_text:
ごめんね～
私までごちそうになっちゃって。

text_block_list.name: Kaya
text_block_list.text: It's okay, it's fine. If anything, you should be grateful that it's all that happened.
text_block_list.orig_text:
いいのいいの。
むしろこれくらいで済んだことに
感謝してほしいくらいだし。

text_block_list.name: Kaya
text_block_list.text: By the way, it might be a little late for me to hit you with this, but... Kaori, you're from Okinawa, correct?
text_block_list.orig_text:
ところで今更なんだけど。
香織って沖縄の人だよね？

text_block_list.name: Kaori
text_block_list.text: That's right. Have you been to Okinawa before, Kaya?
text_block_list.orig_text:
そうだよ～。
嘉夜は沖縄行ったことあるの～？

text_block_list.name: Kaya
text_block_list.text: Unfortunately not. But I'd love to visit someday. I want to go to your popular aquarium, swim in the ocean and also eat delicious food! Ah, I'd just love to live a relaxed life around there for about a month!
text_block_list.orig_text:
残念ながら。
でもいつか行ってみたいと思ってるよ。
水族館行ってみたいし、
海で泳いでおいしいものも食べたい！
あー、
もういっそのこと
一ヶ月くらいのんびり暮らしたい！

text_block_list.name: Kaori
text_block_list.text: Aha~♪ I'm glad to hear you talking about my hometown like that~ If you ever come to Okinawa, please let me know~sa
text_block_list.orig_text:
あは～♪　
故郷のことをそんなふうに言ってくれてうれしいよ～
もし沖縄に来るときは連絡してほしいさ～

text_block_list.name: Kaori
text_block_list.text: I'll show you loooots of wonderful places in Okinawa~!
text_block_list.orig_text:
沖縄の素敵な所、
い～っぱい案内するからね～

text_block_list.name: Kaya
text_block_list.text: Ahaha, sounds fun, I'm looking forward to it. By the way, why are you here, Kaori? Sightseeing? Hmm, even considering that, it seems like you're pretty close with Senpai.
text_block_list.orig_text:
あはは、
それは楽しみだな。
ところで香織って何でこっちに来てるの？　
観光？
んー、
そのわりにはセンパイと随分親しい気がするな。

text_block_list.name: Kaori
text_block_list.text: I came here for a karate tournament~ The tournament is over now, but I plan on staying here for a while~sa!
text_block_list.orig_text:
私は空手の大会でこっちに来たんだよ～
大会はもう終わってるけど、
しばらくこっちにいるつもりなんさ～

text_block_list.name: Kaya
text_block_list.text: ...Hmm, karate. You can't judge a book by its cover.
text_block_list.orig_text:
……ふーん、
空手の。
人は見かけによらないね。

text_block_list.name: Kaori
text_block_list.text: The fact that you're also a karate girl is cool, Kaya~sa!
text_block_list.orig_text:
そういう嘉夜は
いかにも空手少女って感じでカッコいいさ～

text_block_list.name: Kaya
text_block_list.text: Huh...?

text_block_list.name: Kaori
text_block_list.text: If you look at those hands, you can tell~ They're the hands of someone who's seriously devoted themselves to karate~sa.
text_block_list.orig_text:
その手を見れば分かるよ～
真面目に空手に打ち込んできた人の手さ～

text_block_list.name: Kaya
text_block_list.text: I-I see. Haha, that's amazing, Kaori...
text_block_list.orig_text:
そ、
そっか。
はは、
すごいね、
香織……

text_block_list.name: Kaori
text_block_list.text: Uh? Kaya...? ...He said you "did" karate. Does that mean......?
text_block_list.orig_text:
嘉夜？　
……
空手「やってた」って、
もしかして……

text_block_list.name: Kaya
text_block_list.text: Ahaha, well... a lot has happened, you see...
text_block_list.orig_text:
あはは、
まあ、
色々あって、
ね……

text_block_list.name: Kaori
text_block_list.text: ...You know, other than karate, I also love singing and dancing~sa.
text_block_list.orig_text:
……あのね、
私空手以外にも
歌や踊りが大好きさ～

text_block_list.name: Kaya
text_block_list.text: Eh? S-Sure. And?
text_block_list.orig_text:
え、
う、
うん。
それで？

text_block_list.name: Kaori
text_block_list.text: I love it, but I don't want to become a professional and make a living from it. I just want to be able to spend every day having fun and relaxing. That's what I think~sa!
text_block_list.orig_text:
好きだけど、
プロになって
それで生活したいとかは考えてなくて、
ただ毎日楽しくのんびり過ごせればいい、
そう考えてるんさ～

text_block_list.name: Kaori
text_block_list.text: But... sometimes when I see people who are working hard towards their own dreams, or who are seriously devoting themselves to what they love, I wonder if that kind of mentality is right to have~sa.
text_block_list.orig_text:
でも、
たまに自分の夢に一生懸命な人、
好きなことに本気で打ち込んでる人を見ると、
私はこのままでいいのかな～？　
って、
考える時があるさ～

text_block_list.name: Kaori
text_block_list.text: When that happens, both my singing and dancing get a little off-course~
text_block_list.orig_text:
そうなると、
歌や踊りがちょっと調子悪くなっちゃうんだよ～

text_block_list.name: Kaya
text_block_list.text: ...So, what do you do if that happens?
text_block_list.orig_text:
……それで、
そうなったらどうするの？

text_block_list.name: Kaori
text_block_list.text: When that time comes, I stop dancing and singing for a while. I'll do something fun, like karate, or chat with friends and forget about it.
text_block_list.orig_text:
その時は一旦離れるさ～。
他の楽しいこと、
空手に打ち込んだり、
友達といっぱいおしゃべりして
忘れるんだよ～

text_block_list.name: Kaya
text_block_list.text: Can I really just forget about it? Isn't that just like running away?
text_block_list.orig_text:
忘れていいの？　
それって逃げてることにならない？

text_block_list.name: Kaori
text_block_list.text: It's okay to run away~sa! Life is a long road, you know? If you keep carrying around painful things as you walk, you'll get tired.
text_block_list.orig_text:
逃げたっていいんさ～。
だって人生は長いんだよ～？
辛いことを抱えたままじゃ
疲れちゃうからね～

text_block_list.name: Kaori
text_block_list.text: So, even if you distance yourself, if it's something that's really important to you... eventually you'll meet again on your walk through life~sa!
text_block_list.orig_text:
で、
距離をおいても
本当に大事なものなら、
また自然と戻ってるはずさ～

text_block_list.name: Kaya
text_block_list.text: Kaori... Thank you. Somehow, I've made you worry about me, sorry, ahaha......... If even a girl like you has such worries, it's only natural that someone like me would too.
text_block_list.orig_text:
香織……
ありがとう。
何か気ぃ使わせちゃったね、
あはは……
香織みたいな子でも悩むんなら、
私なんかが悩むのも当然だよね。

text_block_list.name: Kaori
text_block_list.text: Aha~ even I get cold feet sometimes~ Ah, I know, I want to spar with you next time we meet, Kaya~sa
text_block_list.orig_text:
あは～、
私だってブルーになることくらいあるよ～
そ
うだ、
今度会った時は
嘉夜と手合わせしたいさ～

text_block_list.name: Kaya
text_block_list.text: ...I wonder if I'm up to it.
text_block_list.orig_text:
……できるかな、
アタシに。

text_block_list.name: Kaori
text_block_list.text: You’ve got this, Kaya~sa! Besides, right by your side, you have {0}. Then nothing's a big deal~
text_block_list.orig_text:
嘉夜ならできるさ～。
それに、
嘉夜の側には彼がいるからね。
なんくるないさ～

text_block_list.name: Kaya
text_block_list.text: ...Hmph, it's annoying to see Senpai with such a smug look on his face, but I'll try my best. So... See you then, Kaori.
text_block_list.orig_text:
……
ふっ、
センパイにドヤ顔されるのはしゃくだけど、
努力はしてみるよ。
だから……
また会おうね、
香織。

text_block_list.name: Kaori
text_block_list.text: Yeah!  I’ll be there~sa♪
text_block_list.orig_text:
うん！　
必ずさ～♪

text_block_list.name: Kaya
text_block_list.text: Hmm, uuu... Huh, did I fall asleep in a place like this? Seriously, that's way too carefree coming from me! I'm not Kaori!
text_block_list.orig_text:
ん、
うぅ……
あれ、
オレこんなとこで寝ちまってたのか？
マジかよ、
だらけ過ぎだろ！　
カオリじゃあるまいし！

text_block_list.name: Kaori
text_block_list.text: Nothing of the sort~ I'm fine with sleeping outside, but I won't sleep in any dangerous places~ More importantly, I just had a weird dream~sa...
text_block_list.orig_text:
心外さ～。
野宿は全然平気だけど、
危ない所で寝たりはしないよ～
それより私、
今変な夢を見たさ～

text_block_list.name: Kaya
text_block_list.text: Huh? What, you did too, Kaori? Huh, you too, {0}? So... don't tell me that was the clue to your memories?
text_block_list.orig_text:
あん？　
なんだカオリもかよ。
え、
キミも？
ってことは、
今のがキミの記憶の手がかりってやつだったのか？

text_block_list.name: Kaori
text_block_list.text: So how about it? Have your memories returned...?
text_block_list.orig_text:
どう～？　
キミの記憶、
戻ったかな～？

text_block_list.name: Kaya
text_block_list.text: I guess that was a miss... It's unfortunate, but we'll have to call it a day here.
text_block_list.orig_text:
ハズレだったか……
残念だけど、
今日のところはここらで引き上げるとしようか。

text_block_list.name: Kaya
text_block_list.text: Ah, um... ...Kaori, I appreciate all the kindness you've shown me today. I'll thank you, and those thanks include the ones from my lookalike in that dream. Thanks.
text_block_list.orig_text:
あ、
と……
カ
オリ、
色々世話になったな。
夢ん中のオレのそっくりさんも含めて
礼を言っておくよ。
ありがとな。

text_block_list.name: Kaori
text_block_list.text: It's nothing, nothing really~ I had a lot of fun too, so you could say we're even~sa!
text_block_list.orig_text:
なんのなんの～
私もい～っぱい楽しかったから
おあいこさ～

text_block_list.name: Kaya
text_block_list.text: Now then, let's head back to the city. Oh yeah, let's spar as soon as we get out of the Tower!
text_block_list.orig_text:
それじゃあ街に戻るとするか。
そうだ、
塔を出たら
さっそく手合わせしようぜ！

text_block_list.name: Kaori
text_block_list.text: Eeehhh? But I'm so exhausted~sa... Aren't you the same, Kaya?
text_block_list.orig_text:
え～、
さすがにもうへとへとさ～
カヤもお疲れじゃないの？

text_block_list.name: Kaya
text_block_list.text: What are you talking about? Don't they say the energy for fighting is in another stomach or something?
text_block_list.orig_text:
何言ってんだよ。
昔からケンカは別腹って言うだろ？

text_block_list.name: Kaori
text_block_list.text: That's... the first time I've heard such a saying. But, I've made you a promise in that dream. It can't be helped then, just once~sa!
text_block_list.orig_text:
それは初耳だよ～。
でも、
夢の中で約束したもんね～
仕方ない、
一度だけさ～

text_block_list.name: Kaya
text_block_list.text: Hehe, that's more like it! Ahhhh, I'm getting excited!
text_block_list.orig_text:
へへ、
そうこなくっちゃな！　
あー、
たぎってきたぜ！

text_block_list.name: Narration
text_block_list.text: Kaya and Kaori smile as they exchange punches. After this, the two of them will fight many times as friends and also as worthy rivals... but that's a story for another time.
text_block_list.orig_text:
笑顔で拳を交わし合うカヤとカオリ。
この後二人は友として、そして好敵手として
幾度も激闘を繰り広げることになるが、それはまた別のお話。
